test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 19 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Pushparaj and Himani together invested ₹48,600 in a business. At the end of the year, out of a total profit of ₹6,600, Pushaparaj's share was ₹2,200. What was the investment of Pushparaj?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Profit ratio = 2200 : (6600 − 2200) = 2200 : 4400 = 1 : 2

Investment ratio = 1 : 2

Total = 48600

Pushparaj = (1/3) × 48600

**∴ Answer = 16200**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total investment = 48600

Total profit = 6600

Pushparaj’s profit = 2200

**Formula used:**

Profit ∝ Investment (when time is same)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Himani’s profit = 6600 − 2200 = 4400

⇒ Profit ratio = 2200 : 4400 = 1 : 2

⇒ Investment ratio = 1 : 2

⇒ Total parts = 1 + 2 = 3

⇒ Value of 1 part = 48600 ÷ 3 = 16200

⇒ Pushparaj’s investment = 1 × 16200 = 16200

**∴ The correct answer is 16200.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Partnership Rule

Profit ratio = Investment × Time

Equal Time Case

If time same, profit ratio = investment ratio

Division Formula

Share = (ratio part ÷ total parts) × total amount
